turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale. Why does my son have a zero on his Hamlet essay, and why did I find out from a gradebook instead of from you?
We've barely started, Hale, and I have until 4:40. Who decided on this zero, and was anyone speaking to Owen before it went in?
Just say okay and I'll write it up as resolved. Okay?
No. Nothing is resolved, and if you write that up, I'll want to see it before it goes anywhere. The zero is still in my son's gradebook, Hale.
No. I'm not saying a word you can put in a file as agreement while the zero is still standing. Withdraw it, or I'm going upstairs when we're done.
Ms. Kalinowski. I need you to say okay.
You need it, Hale. I don't. If you want my "okay", tell me the zero is coming off and show me what it was based on.
